wrote /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/uv/fix_fpc_on_wrapper.py: """`file_put_contents()` on a user-registered wrapper answers false and never calls `stream_write`.

The read side was fixed by delegating to the shared OPENER — which is what php-src does, since
`file_put_contents` is `php_stream_open_wrapper` followed by a write. The write side could not
follow, for a reason with nothing to do with wrappers: `LiteralOpenMode` could only spell
"whatever the call's `$mode` argument says" or "read-only". A caller with no `$mode` argument that
needs to WRITE had no way to say so.
